en.title: Fire destroys Marché des Enfants Rouges, Paris's oldest covered food market
en.summary: A fire destroyed the Marché des Enfants Rouges, Paris's oldest covered food market and a listed historical monument, overnight Sunday to Monday, resulting in one minor injury.

en.summary: African nations have established a new rating agency, citing major credit agencies' lack of on-site analysts and understanding of informal markets in Africa. The new institute must convince financial markets of its independence.
